$comment: What the bake-off can compare (docs/voice-bakeoff.md). `models` is the researched list (checked 2026-10-27, sources in the doc). The page's model picker shows it before a key is entered, then the provider's own live list once one is. `tags`: takes bracketed audio tags ([whispers]); `context`: takes previous_text/next_text; `dialogue`: has a one-request multi-speaker mode. `presets` are the columns a fresh page starts with, and what the command line renders. `fake` makes tones so the page can be tried with no keys.

models.label: Eleven v4
models.about: Newest. Built for expressive long-form narration; follows audio tags.

models.label: Eleven v4 Turbo
models.about: v4 for real-time use, at half the price.

models.label: Multilingual v2
models.about: Steady and proven. No audio tags; takes neighboring lines as context.

models.label: Flash v2.5
models.about: Lowest latency and cost. No audio tags.

models.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS
models.about: Newest Flash TTS. Audio tags and style prompts; two-speaker mode.

models.label: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS (preview)
models.about: The first Gemini TTS with audio tags.

models.label: Fake tones
models.about: No key, no voice: a tone as long as the words. For trying the page.
